name: Royal Titans

mechanics.name: Branda the Fire Queen
mechanics.description: The fire half of the pair. She fights in melee and burns what she hits.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Melee. Keep her health level with Eldric's, since killing one alone does nothing.

mechanics.name: Eldric the Ice King
mechanics.description: The ice half. He fights in melee alongside Branda and freezes what he hits.
mechanics.counterplay: Same prayer, same job. The two have to die close together or the survivor brings the other back.

mechanics.name: Summoned Minions
mechanics.description: Both titans call up minions of their own element through the fight.
mechanics.counterplay: Clear them as they arrive. Leaving them to build up is what turns the fight around.

mechanics.name: Branda's Eruption
mechanics.description: Branda's area attack, thrown across a patch of the arena rather than at one target.
mechanics.counterplay: Move out of the marked area. No prayer covers standing in it.

mechanics.name: Repositioning
mechanics.description: Both titans teleport around the arena rather than walking, so the shape of the fight keeps changing.
mechanics.counterplay: Reposition with them and keep both in reach, or you end up splitting damage badly between the two.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). ONE COLLECTION LOG PAGE COVERS TWO BOSSES, which is why npcIds holds both: Branda the Fire Queen 12596 and Eldric the Ice King 14147. They are in npcIds rather than treated as spawns because both are present for the whole fight, the same call General Graardor's sergeants ship under. THE TWO HAVE COMPLETELY SEPARATE ANIMATION SETS, laid out as matching pairs one number apart: ICE_GIANT_ELDRIC_KING_* takes the odd-numbered id and FIRE_GIANT_BRANDA_QUEEN_* the even one, through IDLE (11969, 11970), WALK (11971, 11972), ATTACK_MELEE (11973, 11974), ATTACK_SUMMON01 (11975, 11976), ATTACK_SUMMON02 (11977, 11978) and TELEPORT (11983, 11984). That pairing is what lets each titan have its own mechanic with an exact trigger rather than sharing one. BRANDA HAS TWO AOE SEQUENCES AND ELDRIC HAS NONE. FIRE_GIANT_BRANDA_QUEEN_ATTACK_AOE01 11981 and AOE02 11982 exist with no ICE_GIANT equivalent at 11979 or 11980, so either Eldric genuinely has no area attack or his sits elsewhere in the set. The file follows the cache and gives the eruption to Branda alone. Both summon sequences from both titans are curated on a single summons mechanic, since the counterplay is the same whichever element arrives. No projectile is curated: the cache names no BRANDA, ELDRIC or ROYAL_TITAN spotanim. Both previews resolve through npcId and fitted normally, so unlike most of this batch these are real arithmetic rather than a bind-pose estimate; struct 1744, the Combat Achievements entry, pins Branda's model 55951 at zoom 2500, close to the 2744 fitted here, which corroborates the fit. staticFallback is false on all five; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Royal Titans', matching 'name'.
